title: ext4 日志演算室：事务描述块、revoke 与崩溃点回放
narrative: 文件系统团队导入 ext4/JBD2 块快照、superblock 与预期崩溃点，生成可解释的日志扫描与回放计划。

sources.expect: diagnostic-only: not a power of two, kept raw, never normalised

boundaries: ring-wraparound: sequences FE FF 00 01 02 ordered on the ring, never by integer sort
half-transaction: seq 2 has descriptor+data but no commit before crash point
duplicate-block: fs block 10 written in seq FE and seq 0; ring-last committed writer wins
rewrite-after-revoke: fs block 11 revoked in seq 0, rewritten in seq 1
checksum-break: seq 1 commit checksum corrupted; boundary after it stays uncertain
invalid-block-size: 1000 bytes kept raw with diagnostic
idempotent-replay: applying the derived block map twice is a no-op the second time
semantics: only transactions with a complete valid commit may replay
revoke applies by ring sequence range (equal-or-later revoker cancels)
ring wraparound never uses plain integer ordering
after a checksum failure the boundary keeps uncertainty; all legal candidates are retained
